steps.goal: Use Attribute Wrangle to assign unique point names to joints
steps.group: Expand to multi-chain rig and update targets
common_mistakes: Leaving duplicate default names causing APEX control mapping conflicts.
Using Stash Input when you want to keep your work: it removes all existing changes and copies the input. Use Stash Merge Input to append instead. (official: SideFX Houdini docs: Skeleton (SOP))

Expecting Delete to remove a joint's children: it reparents them to the deleted joint's parent; Shift+Delete leaves them with their old parent chain broken. (official: SideFX Houdini docs: Skeleton (SOP))
Leaving On Failure at Error while experimenting: a failure stops everything downstream from cooking. (official: SideFX Houdini docs: Rig Doctor (SOP))
assumptions: Before this: You are working at SOP level, in a geometry network, because the Skeleton node is a SOP.
Before this: A SOP skeleton on the input.
